# Florida Life Insurance
Canonical URL: https://florida-life-insurance.com

> Florida Life Insurance is a Florida-focused life insurance resource and
> online quoting platform run by Matt Saffian, a licensed Florida resident
> insurance agent (License #G273626). The site helps Florida residents
> understand their life insurance options in plain language, compare term,
> whole, universal, final expense, burial, senior, no-medical-exam, and
> guaranteed issue coverage side by side, and request a personalized quote
> online through an embedded BackNine quote-and-apply tool — with a real
> licensed agent behind every request, not a call center.

Florida Life Insurance is focused exclusively on Florida consumers. It is
not a national insurance directory and does not currently cover other
states. Product availability, pricing, and eligibility vary by carrier and
are subject to underwriting — no product on this site is guaranteed to be
available to every applicant, and nothing on the site is a binding offer of
insurance.

## Get a Quote

- [Get a Free Quote](https://florida-life-insurance.com/get-a-quote/): Request a personalized Florida life insurance quote online via the embedded BackNine quote-and-apply widget.

## Coverage Types

- [Life Insurance (overview)](https://florida-life-insurance.com/life-insurance/): Pillar guide to every coverage type available in Florida, how underwriting works, and how to size a coverage amount.
- [Term Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/term-life-insurance/): Temporary coverage for a specific period (10, 15, 20, or 30 years).
- [Whole Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/whole-life-insurance/): Permanent coverage with a cash value component.
- [Universal Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/universal-life-insurance/): Flexible permanent coverage with adjustable premiums, including indexed (IUL) and guaranteed (GUL) variants.
- [Final Expense Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/final-expense-insurance/): Simplified-issue coverage for funeral, burial, and cremation costs.
- [Burial Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/burial-insurance/): Coverage focused specifically on funeral and burial costs, compared against pre-need funeral contracts.
- [Senior Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/senior-life-insurance/): Life insurance options for older adults by age range and health situation.
- [No Medical Exam Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/no-medical-exam-life-insurance/): Simplified issue, accelerated underwriting, and guaranteed issue coverage compared side by side.
- [Guaranteed Issue Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/guaranteed-issue-life-insurance/): Coverage available without health questions, within eligible age ranges, including how the graded death benefit works.
